blocks.text: American pop-rock band LANY has canceled the Davao stop of its “Soft” world tour on Nov. 14, citing “safety concerns and production issues.” This was announced by concert promotion company Live Nation Philippines through its social media pages on Wednesday, Oct. 28. “We regret to inform you that LANY: soft world tour, scheduled for Nov. 14, 2026, at Crocodile Park Concert Grounds in Davao, has been cancelled due to safety concerns and production issues,” it said. No further details about the reason for the cancellation were immediately disclosed. For the affected ticket holders, the company offered the option for them to […]...
